notes.title: Update 1.2.0 & The future
notes.notes: [p]Hey, it's been a while! I've been busy working on Sunset Humanity's sequel, Akashic Slingshot, which should hopefully be releasing early next year. However I thought I'd spend a little time polishing some of Sunset Humanity's rough edges in the form of a minor update.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Story / Cutscenes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Extended ending cutscene[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Schrodinger's tea party dialogue[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed "Project Slingshot" website to "Akashic Slingshot".[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Accessibility[/b][/p][list][*][p]Mouse sensitivity can now be adjusted[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]The Future[/b][/p][p]I offer my deepest gratitude to everyone who played Sunset Humanity. Your feedback, comments, and videos have been truly invaluable. Whilst this will likely be the last update to Sunset Humanity, the story will live on in Akashic Slingshot. The demo for which will be releasing July 31st, so be sure to check it out![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3875800/Akashic_Slingshot_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Akashic Slingshot, a sequel billions of years in the making.
notes.notes:
After 4 years of development, I'm happy to unveil Akashic Slingshot, the sequel to Sunset Humanity!

Unlike its predecessor, Akashic Slingshot features combat, multiple endings, and a vast world to explore, with the most major change being the shift from 3D to 2D. I can't explain much about the switch without getting into spoiler territory, however I can assure you the surrealist aesthetic of Sunset Humanity will continue. 

Set billions of years after the events of Sunset Humanity, Akashic Slingshot aims to answer all the questions left unanswered in Sunset Humanity's story, whilst providing a much more engaging (and longer) experience. Wishlist now!
